name: time reference
qick: QICK output ~31.6-32.6 sg_clk after due (E5); release +4 t_clk
riscq_native: output at due+0, params pop early (-52..-2)
conversion_action: startTime = QICK due + ~32 batches or define golden convention

name: busy/overlap
qick: chains after previous end, nothing lost
riscq_native: dur counter reload truncates previous pulse, no flag

name: issue order != due order
qick: both played in issue order, full length

name: late command
riscq_native: released immediately, stale amp/phase ~32 batches, env ~9
conversion_action: guarantee lead >= ~55 batches or detect lateness

name: capacity
riscq_native: 5 per queue, silent drop, CPU not stalled
conversion_action: throttle to 5 pending per channel or add backpressure

name: reset/rerun
riscq_native: abort does not cancel queued pulses; power-up stray pulses
conversion_action: explicit drain/flush; hold reset before load
